## Entity Structure

**Sponsor entity:** Ridgeback Peak Properties LLC (Louisiana LLC, formed [DATE])
— manages all acquisitions, investor relations, and asset management.

**Deal entity:** A single-purpose LLC is formed for each acquisition (e.g.,
"[Property Address] Partners LLC") and takes title to the property. Ridgeback Peak
Properties LLC serves as the managing member. Borrower on the loan will be the
deal-level SPE, guaranteed by [YOUR NAME] personally.

**Equity structure:** Deals are capitalized through a family limited partnership
([LP NAME, e.g., "Mekdessie Family LP"]) as primary limited partner, alongside
Ridgeback Peak Properties LLC as general partner / managing member. LP commits equity
capital; GP manages the deal and earns a promote above an 8% preferred return to LP.

## Underwriting Standards

**DSCR sizing:** Internal underwriting targets 1.30x DSCR at the requested loan amount
against year-1 stabilized NOI. This exceeds the typical 1.25x bank minimum and provides
a cushion against vacancy or expense variance.

**Expense benchmarking:** Operating expenses are benchmarked against third-party
comparables and, where applicable, Stoa Group's Louisiana operating history. Insurance
is verified by actual quote before any offer is made; property tax is verified against
the parcel record (not the seller's T-12).

**Income verification:** Gross potential rent is cross-checked against rent comps
(CoStar / Crexi) and the actual in-place rent roll. Occupancy is underwritten to market
vacancy (minimum 7%), not current occupancy, unless trailing occupancy supports a
tighter figure over 12+ months.

**Dual valuation:** Each deal is valued on both (a) income approach (NOI ÷ market cap
rate) and (b) cost or sales-comparison approach. We do not submit offers above both
floors without a documented thesis.

**Management:** All properties managed by a licensed third-party property management
company. Management fee (typically 8–10% of effective gross revenue) is underwritten as
a hard expense, not added back.

## Acquisition Process & IC Memo

Every deal submitted for financing arrives with a system-generated Investment Committee
(IC) memorandum that includes:
- Property summary and rent roll analysis
- T-12 normalized to Ridgeback Peak underwriting assumptions
- Loan sizing (LTV and DSCR binding), debt service schedule
- 11-year levered IRR and equity multiple (base, downside, upside cases)
- LP waterfall and return profile
- Sensitivity table (exit cap × rent growth)
- Variance from benchmark assumptions — flagged

This memo is available to lenders at time of loan application.
